caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The object is a pedestal or architectural base with a square top, flaring outward at the sides before narrowing at the midsection and then widening again at its base, creating a curved profile. The pedestal is rendered in shades of reddish-brown, tan, and muted pink, giving the surface a marbled or stone-like texture. The sides feature a prominent circular medallion with a carved, radial rosette pattern in the center of the midsection. The base is layered, resting on several rectangular blocks or plinths that extend out beneath the main structure. Light and shadow are used to give the object a three-dimensional appearance. In the bottom right corner of the drawing, the name "Raymond E. Noble" is written in small capital letters. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition.
title: Stand for Baptismal Font
